items.text: HEG Graphite lists in late October: add it to its sector note once it trades, with its ₹650cr electrode expansion to 115,000 tonnes (due early 2028) as a project.
Compare the exchange transcript pull with Tijori for the Q2 season, then decide whether to retire Tijori.
SKF India has filed Q2 results: put it into the Bearings live table.

Ganesh Benzoplast is selling its storage and rail-logistics businesses for ₹1,154cr (more than its market value): once the sale closes, rewrite its section in the Oil note for the chemicals-and-EPC company that remains, and decide its call.
